notes.md: - **cVIGIL (ECI app):** citizens report Model Code of Conduct violations with live photos or videos; the ECI aims to act on each complaint **within 100 minutes**; the app works only where elections are announced.
- **Legal services:** the **Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987** came into force on **9 November 1995**; **9 November** is observed as **National Legal Services Day**; NALSA works under this Act.

- **SC-appointed National Task Force (Aug 2024):** set up by the Supreme Court (Bench of CJI **D.Y. Chandrachud**) after the **RG Kar Hospital (Kolkata)** case to frame safety protocols for doctors; headed by **Surgeon Vice Admiral Arti Sarin**, DG Medical Services (Navy).

- **More Survey concepts:** **Chakravyuha Challenge** (easy entry but hard exit for firms) - **Economic Survey 2015–16** (CEA **Arvind Subramanian**); **Bare Necessities Index** (access to water, sanitation, housing, micro-environment and other facilities) - **Economic Survey 2020–21**.
